name: SRT Sandbox
description: Docker-free local sandbox backend for OpenClaw built on the Anthropic Sandbox Runtime (macOS Seatbelt).

binShell.label: Shell
binShell.help: Absolute path to the POSIX shell used to run sandboxed commands. Defaults to /bin/bash.

network.label: Network
network.help: Network posture for sandboxed commands. 'deny' blocks all outbound network (default); 'allow' leaves it open.

writablePaths.label: Extra Writable Paths
writablePaths.help: Additional absolute paths added to the sandbox writable allowlist beyond the scope workspace directories.
